title: TAXNMY publisher
description: Whoever publishes the updates of a product. Stored as publishers/<publisher>.yaml. The form of the key (rule TR2) and uniqueness (rule TR3) are checked by tools/lint.py, not by this schema.

key.description: The publisher part of a product key, written with the writing rule. Never changes and is never reused.

name.description: The Latin name the publisher uses itself, as the source writes it.

source.description: The page where the publisher uses this name.

machine_sources.description: Sources the publisher makes for machines, where its updates can be read without a web page: an update catalog, AppStream metadata or CSAF provider metadata. Optional. Step 0 of the referee's ladder can read them (referee/README.md).

url.description: Where the source for machines is.

format.description: The format of the source: update-catalog (a Manifest of SoftwareComponent), appstream (AppStream metadata) or csaf-provider (a CSAF provider-metadata.json).

source.description: The page of the publisher that names this source for machines.

aliases.description: Earlier or other keys of this publisher.
